core_value_proposition: For Chief Compliance Officers at large financial institutions who need to demonstrate AI model compliance to regulators, ComplianceAI provides an integrated platform that automatically documents model behavior, generates regulatory reports, and provides explainability evidence—enabling them to audit 50+ models in weeks instead of months and avoid regulatory enforcement action.

differentiation_strategy.defensibility_rationale: Requires deep knowledge of Fed/SEC/OCC guidance; difficult for monitoring companies to build legal/compliance layer
differentiation_strategy.competitive_comparison: ModelWatch focuses on monitoring; we provide compliance-ready audit trail

differentiation_strategy.why_matters_to_customer: Regulatory pressure is immediate; slow implementations miss windows
